data.name: Layout_EngineDesc
data.value: Merges OCR words into paragraphs using distance thresholds

data.name: Layout_WordGapThreshold_Desc
data.value: Max gap along the baseline between words to merge into a line (% of word height); also used as snap tolerance for line ends vs the previous frame

data.name: Layout_BaselineDriftTolerance_Desc
data.value: Maximum drift of word centers perpendicular to reading direction (% of word height) to merge into a line

data.name: Layout_AngleToleranceDegrees_Desc
data.value: Max angle difference (degrees) for merging words into a line, lines into a paragraph, and matching a previous-frame line

data.name: Layout_LineSpacingThreshold_Desc
data.value: Max center-to-center distance along the paragraph normal (% of average line height) to merge lines into a paragraph

data.name: Layout_LineOverhangTolerancePercent_Desc
data.value: Merge lines if at least one stays within the other along reading; max overhang as % of line height (100 ≈ one character)

data.name: Layout_VerticalColumns_Desc
data.value: Experimental. Assemble CJK glyphs (and upright punctuation/digits / square numbers) into top-to-bottom columns and read columns right to left. For manga when OCR returns characters with no rotation.

data.name: Layout_FontSizeTolerance_Desc
data.value: Max allowed height difference between lines (% of average line height) to still merge them into one paragraph

data.name: Layout_EnableStabilization_Desc
data.value: Snap line bounds to the previous frame, smooth text flicker, and keep unmatched paragraphs as ghosts

data.name: Layout_HoldNewBlocks_Desc
data.value: Hold a paragraph until its original text matches the previous frame, or until the previous paragraph was already shown and the normalized text is similar (within the text match threshold)

data.name: Layout_CenterThresholdXPercent_Desc
data.value: Along-reading match window (% of line height; 300 = 3×height): how far past previous-line ends a word may still match, and max drift of line start or end vs the previous line (at least one end must stay within this)

data.name: Layout_CenterThresholdYPercent_Desc
data.value: How far off the previous baseline to still match a word (% of line height; 75 = 0.75×height)

data.name: Layout_LevenshteinThreshold_Desc
data.value: Max Levenshtein distance (% of longer compare-key) to treat linked readings as the same; then longer text wins, equal length keeps previous

data.name: Layout_GhostMaxFrames_Desc
data.value: How many frames to keep an unmatched previous paragraph visible (0 = disable ghosts)

data.name: Layout_ParagraphMergeHysteresisPercent_Desc
data.value: Loosen or tighten merge tolerances to prefer the previous frame's line and paragraph structure (100 = off, 120 = ×1.2 when preferring merge, ×1/1.2 when preferring split)

data.name: Layout_SameLineWordGapHysteresisPercent_Desc
data.value: How far along the baseline to pull words that shared a previous-frame line (100 = normal gap, 600 = 6×; bridges dropped tokens)

data.name: Layout_WordFilters_Desc
data.value: Filter OCR words before lines are built

data.name: Layout_LineFilters_Desc
data.value: Filter lines before paragraphs are built
